paite: Ka tapa, na inveng a dia moh khu dia nai dinleh mikhual a ding a na khut na kichiamleh,
heading: Thuhilhna Tamsem

paite: na kam a thute a awk na hih a, na kam a thute a mat na hihleh,
tu in hiai hih in, ka tapa, nang leh nang kihonkhia in, na inveng khut sung ah na om chih thei in; kuan in, nang leh nang kiniamkhiak inla, na inveng va ngen ngutngut in.
Na mitte ihmusak ke'nla, na mitvunte leng lususak sam ke'n.
Gamvakpa khut a sakhipi bang leh thangkampa khut a vasa bang in kihonkhia in.
Miksi kiang ah hoh in, nang thadah; alampite ngaihtuah inla, pil in.
Hausa, heutu, hiam vaihawmmi, nei lou in,
nipi chiang in an asutuah ua, pawltak chiang in an akaikhawm hi.
Bang tan ihmu ding na hia, aw thadah? Na ihmutna a kipan chikchiang a thou ding na hia?
Neukha ihmut lai, neukha lusuk, ihmu ding a neukha khutte khep.
Huchi in na gentheihna guta bang in ahong pai dia, huan na taksapna mi kigalthuam bang in.
Miphatuamlou, migilou; kam ki-uangsak toh avak a;
amitte in chiamtehna abawl a, akhete in thu agen a, akhutzungte in chiamtehna abawl a;
alungtang sung ah hoihlouhna a-om a, gilou agel gige a; kilemlouhna atuh naknak hi.
Huaiziak in atuahsiatna thakhat in ahong tung ding a; thakhat a kekgawp in, hihdamna bei in a-om ding hi.
Toupa'n amuhdah thil guk a-om a; ahi, amah a dia kihhuai sagih a-om hi.
Mit ki-uangsakte, lei zuauthei, mihoih sisan suah khutte;
Ngaihtuahna gilou ngaihtuah lungtang, siatna hih ding a kintaite;
Zuauthu gen palai taklou, leh unaute lak a kilemlouhna chi tuh.
Ka tapa, na pa thupiak zui in, huan na nu dan mangngilh ke'n.
heading: Ang Kawm Lou Dia Hilhna

paite: Na lungtang tung ah vial gige inla, na ngawng kim ah gak in.
Na vak chiang in, nang ahon pi ding a; na ihmut chiang in, nang ahon veng ding hi; huan na khanloh chiang in, nang ahon houpih ding hi.
Thupiak lah khawnvak ahi ngal a; huan dan vakna ahi; huchi in hilhna taihilhna hinna lampi ahi.
Numei gilou a kipan leh mikhual lei maitang phatna a kipan in nang hon kem ding hi.
Na lungtang in akilawmna lunggulh ke'n; amitvunte'n nang hon man kei hen.
Numei kizuaknu ziak in pasal tanghou them a mat in a-om hi; huchi in angkawmnu'n hinna manpha azong sek hi.
Mi'n a-angsung ah mei ala thei diam, apuante akang kei diam?
Ahihkeileh mi suangkuangthei sa tung ah avak thei diam, akhete akang kei diam?
Huchibang in kuapeuh invengte zi zuan; kuapeuh amah khoih gawt louh a-om kei ding.
Guta in agilkial ziak a alunggulhna taisak ding kia a agukleh mite'n guta amusit kei uhi.
Himahleh muh a a-omleh, azah sagih in adin ding a; a-inn a van tengteng ape ding hi.
Kuapeuh angkawm theihsiamna bei ahi; amah kha hihse ding a ahih ahi.
Liamnate leh zumhuaite amu ding; huan azahpihhuaina nulmang ahi kei ding.
Mullitna lah mi thangpaihna ahi ngal a; huchi in phulak ni chiang in ahawi kei ding hi.
Tatna alimsak kei ding a; thilpiak tampi pe lechin leng, lungdam in a-om kei ding hi.
